/// Options for `fetch`.
export class FetchOptions {
    /// HTTP method: GET (the default), HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or
    /// OPTIONS.
    method: string = "GET";

    /// Request headers. Cookie, Host, Origin, Referer, Sec-* and Proxy-*
    /// cannot be set.
    headers: Map<string, string>? = null;

    /// Request body as bytes. Not allowed with GET or HEAD.
    body: ArrayBuffer? = null;

    /// Request body as text, sent UTF-8 encoded when `body` is null.
    bodyText: string? = null;

    /// Milliseconds before the request fails with "timeout". 0 means the
    /// default of 30000, and it is capped at 60000.
    timeout: u32 = 0;
}

/// The response to a `fetch` request.
export class Response {
    /// HTTP status code, e.g. 200 or 404.
    status: i32;

    /// The standard reason phrase for `status`, e.g. "Not Found".
    statusText: string;

    /// The final URL, after any redirects.
    url: string;

    /// True when `status` is in the 200-299 range.
    get ok(): bool;

    /// Response headers keyed by lower-case name. Repeated headers are
    /// joined with ", ". Builds a new map on every read.
    get headers(): Map<string, string>;

    /// One header by case-insensitive name, or null when it is absent.
    header(name: string): string?;

    /// Resolves with the body as UTF-8 text.
    text(): Promise<string>;

    /// Resolves with a new copy of the body on every call.
    arrayBuffer(): Promise<ArrayBuffer>;
}

/// Requests an https: URL on a public host and resolves with its `Response`
/// on a later frame, whatever its status. Requests never carry cookies or
/// stored credentials, and the host decides whether scripts may use the
/// network at all. Cancelling the promise aborts the request.
///
/// Failures reject with "<code>: <message>", where code is one of
/// disabled, policy, rateLimited, timeout, aborted, tooLarge or network.
///
/// ```as
/// async load(): Promise<void> {
///     let response = await fetch("https://example.com/data.json");
///     if (response.ok) {
///         let body = await response.text();
///         console.log(body.length.toString());
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export unsafe function fetch(url: string, options: FetchOptions? = null): Promise<Response>;
